items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: There was a fine Viennese composer by the name of Sussmann Shyman

ctx.x: Yes, that's very nice, isn't it. Bud, I'll tell you one thing you didn't -- about this time, I didn't know that you were in a car smash, in '67 or '68.

Yes, as I said, I had been coming to Europe to the U.K. two and three times a year, and then I got into a -- you see the World's Greatest Jazz Band hadn't begun yet. We were doing -- we had done some things for Gibson, out in Colorado, in Denver and then I was living in New York, I was married, I enrolled at New York University, to take a class in composition.
